title: web/public/nmr/: the ¹³C and ¹H shift tables built from nmrshiftdb2, and its licence

components.name: nmrshiftdb2 (www.nmrshiftdb.org), its 'nmrshiftdb2withsignals.sd' data file
components.statement: Contains information from nmrshiftdb2 (www.nmrshiftdb.org), which is made available here under the nmrshiftdb2 Database License (https://nmrshiftdb.nmr.uni-koeln.de/nmrshiftdbhtml/nmrshiftdb2datalicense.txt).
components.evidence: Statement: the notice the app shows with every prediction (web/src/panels/NmrNotice.tsx, the licence's §4.3 example notice plus the licence URI, which §4.3 asks for when there is no hyperlink); THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md uses the same words. Both tables' headers name the source file and its sha256, their generators (web/scripts/build-carbon-table.ts, build-proton-table.ts; the SD file is downloaded from https://sourceforge.net/projects/nmrshiftdb2/files/data/) and carry the notice in a 'licence' field. Text: web/public/nmr/LICENSE-nmrshiftdb2.txt (committed in bdca9e1, 2026-10-24), byte-identical on 2026-10-29 to the licensor's URL (https://nmrshiftdb.nmr.uni-koeln.de/nmrshiftdbhtml/nmrshiftdb2datalicense.txt, not versioned) and to the file in nmrshiftdb2's own SVN repository pinned to revision 2672 (trunk/nmrshiftdb2/src/html/nmrshiftdb2datalicense.txt; the text's URL, which uses SVN's !svn/bc/<revision> form; https://sourceforge.net/p/nmrshiftdb2/code/2672/tree/trunk/nmrshiftdb2/src/html/nmrshiftdb2datalicense.txt?format=raw gives the same bytes). The Wayback Machine's captures of the licensor's URL carry the same content digest from 2015-09-10 to 2026-08-30 (CDX digest SDEP4M4JEWBTHY4QU3QF4ZYGTBUFISHQ). nmrshiftdb2 names no copyright holder in the licence.
components.noCopyright: the database licence names no holder; the notice it asks for is given
